surface.purpose: a global RealPass master switch plus one E3-inspired presentation preference
surface.notes: When RealPass is enabled, one authored physical simulation runs with no subsystem or balance tuning. The global master switch may disable the complete overhaul; the only other editable setting controls the E3-inspired HUD/nameplate presentation.

developmentFeedbackFallback.rule: Attended feedback explicitly accepted barless actor presentation for RealPass-on play. Turning the global RealPass master switch off restores native HUD/nameplate behavior.

publicControls.description: Turns the complete RealPass overhaul on or off. Reload the current save after changing it so every adapter begins from the same state.
Toggles the red E3-inspired first-person HUD and NPC-nameplate visual layer. The physical simulation and modern scanner remain unchanged.

developmentRules: Development profile keys exist only to isolate authorities during compilation, calibration and attended diagnosis.
A release builder fixes gameplay/presentation authority keys to the release profile and diagnostics off.
Individual development authority gates are never persisted as normal player preferences.
The global RealPass master switch is the sole player control allowed to stop the authored overhaul as a whole.
The E3-inspired HUD preference may suppress only the E3-inspired visual skin/nameplate presentation; underlying physical state and consequences continue unchanged while RealPass remains enabled.
binaryPreferenceRule: Public booleans are limited to the complete RealPass master switch and the E3-inspired presentation preference. No individual physical authority, rate, damage, protection, injury, pain, treatment or recovery parameter is player-tunable.
